title: Backup runbook
body:
Nightly backups run at 02:00 UTC and write a compressed snapshot to the archive bucket.

Restore drills happen every quarter. The on-call engineer restores the latest snapshot into a scratch database and compares row counts.

If a backup fails twice in a row, page the storage team.

title: Data retention policy
body:
Customer invoices are retained for seven years.

Application logs are retained for thirty days and then deleted by a scheduled job.

Support tickets are anonymised after two years.

title: Deployment guide
body:
Deployments use a blue green switch behind the load balancer.

A deployment is rolled back when the error rate exceeds two percent for five minutes.

Database migrations must be backward compatible with the previous release.

title: On-call FAQ
body:
The on-call rotation changes every Monday at 10:00 local time.

Escalate to the incident commander when customer impact lasts longer than fifteen minutes.
